summary: A Yes vote authorizes the district to issue up to $830,000,000 in general obligation bonds to repair, construct, and equip college classrooms, sites, and facilities, including for career training programs.

tax.text: A Yes vote authorizes bonds that would be repaid through property taxes to fund district facilities and repairs.
tax.quote: What it does: Authorizes $830 million in bonds for classrooms, labs, job training facilities, technology and repairs.

schools.text: A Yes vote authorizes bonds for classrooms, labs, job training facilities, technology and repairs in the district.
schools.quote: What it does: Authorizes $830 million in bonds for classrooms, labs, job training facilities, technology and repairs.

tax.text: A No vote does not authorize these bonds or the associated property-tax payments.
